prompt.name: password
prompt.label: war.app password
prompt.help: Used once, to sign in to war.app for you, and never stored: only the session war.app gives back is kept. If it stops working (a changed password, say), use Sign in on this connection again.

steps.title: Sign in to war.app
steps.description: This lets the connector reach war.app directly, without your browser. Your password is sent to war.app once, with your war.app email, and then discarded; what is kept is the session war.app gives back, a full-account credential stored as your own secret on this connection. A refused sign-in is not retried for you, because war.app may count failed attempts.
